quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (company release, unaudited; consolidated basis including Winbond Electronics Corp., Nuvoton Technology Corp. and other subsidiaries): revenue of NT$28.249 billion, a 3.44% MoM increase and a 256.67% YoY increase (August 2026: NT$27,308,717 thousand; September 2025: NT$7,920,210 thousand). January-September 2026 consolidated revenue totaled NT$180.43 billion, up 187.39% from the same period in 2025.
